title: How Do Artificial Agents Make Decisions in Light of Visual Data?
abstract: arXiv:2611.05671v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) have demonstrated significant advances in reasoning with visual data, which is particularly important given that much of human knowledge is encoded visually in scientific articles and other sources. However, a gap remains in understanding how artificial agents, powered by VLMs, perceive and navigate decision-making under uncertainty in the presence of visual data. This study explores this gap by evaluating and analyzing autonomous decision-making processes. Building upon prior work in visualization literacy and decision theory, we conducted two complementary studies: one examining how agents perceive and quantify uncertainty encoded in visualizations, and another investigating how artificial agents make decisions based on visual data in the form of images. translated_title: 人工智能体如何根据视觉数据进行决策？
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言模型（VLMs）在利用视觉数据进行推理方面已展现出显著进展，这一点尤为重要，因为人类的大量知识在科学文章和其他来源中是以视觉形式编码的。然而，在理解由视觉-语言模型驱动的人工智能体如何在存在视觉数据的情况下感知并应对不确定性下的决策这一问题上，仍然存在空白。本研究通过评估和分析自主决策过程来探索这一空白。基于先前在可视化素养和决策理论方面的工作，我们开展了两项互补研究：一项研究考察智能体如何感知和量化可视化中编码的不确定性，另一项研究调查人工智能体如何基于图像形式的视觉数据做出决策。我们分析了不同模型和不同可视化类型下的感知准确性与决策表现。我们的结果表明，GPT-4o 表现出最高的准确
tldr: 本研究通过两项互补实验评估了基于视觉-语言模型的人工智能体如何感知可视化中编码的不确定性并基于图像数据做出决策，发现 GPT-4o 在感知准确性方面表现最佳。
en_tdlr: This study evaluates how VLM-powered artificial agents perceive uncertainty encoded in visualizations and make decisions from image data, finding that GPT-4o achieves the highest accuracy.
